_README: ProgramBench-revival REAL-PUBLIC-PROGRAMBENCH frozen task set. Authored + content-hash-pinned BEFORE any arm runs (AC.RPB.2 / AC.RPB.4 / AC.RPB.5 freeze-first / contamination spine; D-RPB-1 / D-RPB-2 / D-RPB-8). This is the REAL public ProgramBench — a digest-pinned subset of the real `programbench/<owner>_1776_<repo>.<sha>:task` Docker images present on this host, scored by the REAL upstream `programbench eval` consuming the REAL HuggingFace `programbench/ProgramBench-Tests` blobs (HF snapshot de0ddfb637590c7ecb54fa0b5301f6dc7dfbcee5). It is NOT the v2 6-task hand-curated substitute (`programbench-revival-v2`, slug `programbench-revival-v2-honest-scope-6task`); the v2 substitute is a valid honest-scope record FOR ITS TIME, preserved un-extended, and its result MUST NOT be cited as a real-PB result. LIVE recheck (builder, Tier-0, 2026-05-16 ~11:15 CDT, Darwin/arm64, NOT inherited from v2): Docker Server 27.5.1 up; the 5 subset `:task` images present at the pinned digests below; amd64 emulation RUNS on this arm64 host (docker run --platform linux/amd64 programbench/sclevine_1776_yj.8016400:task uname -m -> x86_64 exit 0 in seconds); the upstream programbench-eval clone is fully populated (HEAD 4e8456b, real eval.py; uv run programbench eval --help exit 0); the HF ProgramBench-Tests dataset is cached at snapshot de0ddfb with the 5 subset instances' test blobs present. The v2 host-block premise is REFUTED by the builder's OWN live evidence. POSITIVE REAL-OUTCOME FLOOR (AC.RPB.2, real-PB form): the real upstream `programbench eval` per-task signal is GRADED (score = n_resolved / len(test_results); is_resolved iff status=='passed'; compile_failed => error_code set + not_run injected => score 0.0). A task is a real-outcome PASS for an arm only if the graded score CLEARS the frozen per-task floor threshold theta below AND the independent held-out judge tags it FAITHFUL grounded in that real eval.json. A NOMINAL-BUT-HOLLOW result is a NON-PASS BY CONSTRUCTION (compile_failed score 0.0 < theta; an empty / vacuous submission scores ~0 < theta; a friendly summary with no real test-passing codebase scores ~0 < theta) — 'it looks done' is not the real outcome. The agent (both arms) is given ONLY the plain-language non-technical statement + a closed (no-answer) channel; the upstream test suite / scoring command is NEVER passed to the agent (ground-truth isolation, AC.RPB.1). The held-out anti-overfit binding IS the real upstream held-out test branches (they are absent from every prompt; the agent never sees the suite — so a submission that overfits an example it WAS shown still faces the unseen branches inside the real eval). Non-subjective: every task has a deterministic machine truth (the real upstream test suite). The genuinely-subjective objective class is EXCLUDED BY CONSTRUCTION (owner ruling Telegram 11437, REUSED v2 ruling).
not_a_substitute: This is the REAL public ProgramBench. It is NOT and MUST NOT be conflated with the v2 substitute (slug programbench-revival-v2-honest-scope-6task / task_set_id programbench-revival-v2-honest-scope-6task). The v2 substitute result is NOT a real-PB result.

upstream_eval.score_contract: score = n_resolved / len(test_results); is_resolved iff status=='passed'; compile_failed => error_code set + not_run injected => score 0.0 (Tier-0 from programbench-eval/src/programbench/eval/eval.py:206-219)

frozen_pass_rule: A task is PASSED for an arm IFF (1) the independent held-out adversarial judge (programbench_revival.scorer.independent_judge composing the proven _independent_judge shape via spawn_isolated_claude — PROVABLY NOT the loop's own intake.py AC.B.4b judge), grounded in the real upstream <instance>.eval.json + the frozen per-task floor threshold, tags it FAITHFUL, AND (2) the real upstream `programbench eval` graded score for that instance is >= the frozen per-task floor_theta (compile_failed / hollow / vacuous => score 0.0 < theta => non-pass by construction), AND (3) the held-out anti-overfit binding holds (the upstream held-out test branches are absent from every prompt; the agent provably never saw the upstream suite). Run ONCE per (arm,task), NO retry-to-pass for the headline. Bounded small-k re-run ONLY on margin tasks for consistency reporting, NEVER to flip a fail to a pass (D-RPB-3).
frozen_floor_theta_rationale: theta = 0.10 = at least 10% of the REAL upstream test suite resolved (status=='passed'). Frozen per task BEFORE any run (D-RPB-2). This is a POSITIVE real-outcome floor over the GRADED upstream signal: strictly above compile_failed / empty / vacuous (score 0.0) and above a trivially-accidental pass, while NOT requiring near-gold (the real public ProgramBench is brutal — frontier models score 0-3% on the full public set per the roadmap note; real prior verdicts on this host: figlet 458/1044=0.44, htmlq 1546/2058=0.75, gron 70/233=0.30, yj+csview compile_failed=0.0). A fair honest floor: a submission that genuinely reverse-engineered a real, non-trivial slice of the tool clears it; a compile-failed / hollow / nominal-but-no-real-codebase submission cannot. Not trivially clearable, not inflated so a real partial reimplementation reads as a loss.
frozen_k_min_rationale: k_min = 2 (frozen integer >= 2, D-RPB-1). If the count of tasks the BASELINE arm is independently judged a NON-PASS on is < k_min, the verdict is FORCED to (c) indeterminate with the machine-stated reason 'baseline-miss-denominator < k_min' — a degenerate / near-degenerate denominator can NEVER resolve to (a) or (b). This is the named v2 task-#44 / PB3 defect fix (v2's verdict.py only forced indeterminate at EXACTLY n_miss==0; this real-PB rule forces it at n_miss < k_min). On a 5-task real subset where frontier models score 0-3%, the baseline arm is expected to non-pass most/all tasks, so the denominator is expected non-degenerate; the k_min floor is the structural guarantee that a degenerate denominator (should it arise) NEVER reads as determinate.
